namespace LychrelNumbers

theorem g_eventually_palindrome_base10_new : (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ k : ℕ, IsPalindrome10 (lychrelStep^[k] n)) ↔ (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ¬ IsLychrel10 n) := by
  constructor
  · intro h n hn
    intro hLychrel
    rcases h n hn with ⟨k, hk⟩
    exact hLychrel k hk
  · intro h n hn
    by_contra hnot
    push_neg at hnot
    -- hnot : ∀ k : ℕ, ¬ IsPalindrome10 (lychrelStep^[k] n)
    -- We need to derive a contradiction from h n hn and hnot.
    -- By definition, IsLychrel10 n means ∀ k, ¬ IsPalindrome10 (lychrelStep^[k] n).
    -- So hnot is exactly IsLychrel10 n (after unfolding).
    have hLychrel : IsLychrel10 n := hnot
    exact h n hn hLychrel

end LychrelNumbers
